alternatives.name: Use TCP/UDP-aware ECMP
alternatives.assessment: Selected for a reversible trial. Layer 3 hashing sent at least 95% of observed transit bytes through one spine while redundant paths were installed.
alternatives.cost: Existing routers and links. No additional VM memory reservation.

alternatives.name: Add a spine
alternatives.assessment: An additional BGP path would require a Compose rollout and share the same VM. The baseline does not establish an independent forwarding capacity limit per spine.
alternatives.cost: One spine adds a 0.5 CPU limit and a 192 MiB memory limit. The guest reported 4722 MiB available during the baseline.

alternatives.name: Increase endpoint or VM capacity
alternatives.assessment: Shared CPU, virtual interfaces and endpoint processing can cap aggregate throughput. The workload cannot establish how a larger VM would scale.
alternatives.cost: Changing VM resources is outside the experiment’s current resource budget.
